sanskrit_verse: uktapañcaguṇā śāke bīje 'kṣau ṣaḍguṇā smṛtā / lavaṇasvedam adyeṣu vṛddhir aṣṭaguṇā matā / guḍe madhuni caivoktā prayukte cirakālike // BrhS_1,10.18
transliteration: uktapañcaguṇā śāke bīje 'kṣau ṣaḍguṇā smṛtā / lavaṇasvedam adyeṣu vṛddhir aṣṭaguṇā matā / guḍe madhuni caivoktā prayukte cirakālike //
sph_interpretive_translation: In valuation of produce, seeds fivefold, liquids sixfold, salt and fermented substances eightfold increase; in long-stored jaggery and honey, their usage is declared.

Causation aligns with sequential value enhancement

Restoration logic operates via acknowledgment of inherent potential
